profile.headline: Retired at Luke’s (my Dog) House
profile.summary: Extensive experience in most facets of computing, with a specialization in databases, interfaces, data conversion and user interface.  Industry experience includes; Local Government, Telecommunication, Healthcare,  and University Student Management.   Also work in electronic and mechanical design, robotics, woodworking, and photography.  Coaching and mentoring are particular passions, having been a part of every position I have held for the past 10 years.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Support and development.  Microsoft technology stack including; C#, JavaScript, JQuery,  Angular, Bootstrap, SQL Server, Azure, off the shelf software, and others.  We support legacy and work to move to the leading edge. Presently building REST and SOAP interfaces between proprietary off the shelf police and courts systems. Python on AWS Alexa application.  Some of my more recent work has included a web based campaign finance reporting system using C# SQL Server, an offender registration kiosk, including finger print and photo capture, for the PD, and completed certification on Workday Pro Studio.

positions.title: Lead Software Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and program core batch applications and Oracle® Forms fulfilling a variety of client needs. Hold responsibility for design and oversight of various applications supporting multiple functions within the  retirement account record keeping system, including batch application and form development, data communication and synchronization, and support and maintenance functions. Provide technical support to clients and staff, addressing issues in a timely manner and providing effective solutions. Technical lead and mentor to team developers and end users. Collaborate with senior-level management, ensuring adequate resource allocation and cohesive project planning. 

Key Achievements:
* Responsible for design, maintenance, and enhancement of the primary fee collection system.
* Expertly utilized PL/SQL®, Oracle® SQL, Pro*C®, Perl, and various other languages to implement and optimize nightly batch processes.
* Project Lead on multiple critical projects assuring on-time delivery of the application that the clients need to accomplish their goals.
positions.insights: Skills: Database Development · Problem Solving · Oracle Database · Communication · C (Programming Language) · Attention to Detail

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developing and maintaining business intelligence software for our fortune 50 client on the Microsoft BI Stack.  Managing internal IT and cloud based systems.  User interface maintenance and development using Microsoft ASP.net and C#.  Mentoring and knowledge sharing.

Key Achievements:
* Microsoft Business Intelligence Stack: SSIS, SSRS, SSAS
* SQL Server 2008 - 2014
* Cleanup of processing to assure clean nightly processing runs.
* Mentoring of other developers on "Bullet-Proofing" the code for production operations.
* Client requested additions to database and user interface.
* Team lead for moving system to new servers and the latest versions of operating system and database family software

positions.title: Software Support Specialist
positions.description:
Develop and program dynamic Web-based applications fulfilling a variety of client needs. Hold responsibility for design and oversight of flagship Web product, including application and form development, data communication and synchronization, and support and maintenance functions. Remotely install Oracle Forms and Reports product line and provide post-install customer support and troubleshooting. Provide technical support to clients and staff, addressing issues in a timely manner and providing effective solutions. Train sales staff on technical aspects of product presentations. Collaborate with senior-level management, ensuring adequate resource allocation and cohesive project planning. Manage corporate technology infrastructure, including network and workstation configuration and maintenance, backup and recovery, and application server and database administration.

Key Achievements:
* Successfully redesigned and reprogrammed Web Portal portion of flagship product, 
* Expertly utilized C#, VisualBasic, and .NET Platform (1.0 and 2.0) Windows Forms applications, streamlining communication with remote gating system.
* Developed C# and Visual Basic applications for CE .NET 4.1 and 4.2 for synchronization of hand held ticket writers with the clients’ primary Oracle database.
* Programmed PL/SQL libraries for SMTP interface, Payment Gateway, and Mail Merge with Microsoft Word from Oracle Forms 10g web products.
positions.insights: Skills: .NET Framework · Database Development · Problem Solving · Interfaces · Microsoft SQL Server · Communication · Attention to Detail
